declared.title: Meta-emotions in daily life: Associations with emotional awareness and depression
declared.foundIn: docs/design/review-science.md (dossier du pilote, 2026-11-22) ; titre de mémoire de la session

population: adult community sample (n = 79), 7 days of experience sampling

findings.text: Feeling bad about feeling bad is the most frequent emotion about an emotion, and goes with more depressive symptoms

support.sentence: Higher depressive severity was associated with higher likelihood of meta-emotional experiences and specifically negative-negative experiences.
